preconditions.description: The length of the input string S must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string S must be strings.

postconditions.expression: len(longest_palindrome) == max(len(p) for p in [S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1]])
postconditions.description: The length of the returned longest palindrome must be equal to the maximum length of any palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: any(S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)))
postconditions.description: There must exist at least one palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: longest_palindrome == min([S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1]], key=lambda x: (len(x), -S.index(x)))
postconditions.description: The returned longest palindrome must be the first occurring one with the least starting index in case of ties.
